name: bantus
description: Sidebar widget that shows Claude desktop session status
author: HectareBase

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.dist: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
